title: Practice: Compound numerals in every case

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: She is around twenty years of age.
exercises.why: The number agrees in case with the noun: genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: There are six apples in the box.
exercises.why: After «шесть» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: About 80 million bacteria are transferred during a 10 second kiss.
exercises.ru: Около ___ миллионов бактерий передаются во время десятисекундного поцелуя.
exercises.why: The number agrees in case with the noun: genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
After «пять» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: I am not ninety years old yet.
exercises.why: The number agrees in case with the noun: genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Во всём мире почти девятьсот ___ (миллион) человек недоедают.
exercises.prompt: Internationally, almost 900 million people don't have enough to eat.
exercises.why: After «девятьсот» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: He was very tall for a thirteen-year-old.
exercises.ru: Он был очень рослым для своих ___ лет.
exercises.why: The number agrees in case with the noun: genitive. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Buy six meters of that cloth.
exercises.why: After «шесть» the noun is genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
